opening.argument: The presentation is organized around teaching course design, not extracting money, credentials, or private data. Its stated purpose is to show “eight unique ground ideas” that add a twist to a classic, and the title identifies those ideas as Mario Maker 2 ground concepts. The demonstrations remain operational and game-focused: one explains using pipes to switch between day and night while preserving the course layout, while another instructs viewers how to place Fire Piranha Plants so they fall in the same spot. Viewer engagement consists of checking course codes, subscribing, or commenting. Any affiliate links are disclosed as ordinary promotions, with no connection to deception, financial-return claims, harmful outcomes, or a promised result.
